jin_position.description: Allows the model to move the collapsed live JIN avatar to a new position inside the current browser window.
rules: Use to move the collapsed live JIN avatar inside the current browser window as a non-verbal spatial gesture.
Emit marker using exactly this schema <JIN_POSITION> 120px 80px </JIN_POSITION>
Put only the position payload inside the tag body; do not put it in the opening tag.
The first number is x and the second number is y, measured in pixels from the browser window's top-left corner to the avatar panel's top-left corner.
Labeled payload values are also valid, for example <JIN_POSITION> x:120px y:80px </JIN_POSITION>.
Use CURRENT_WINDOW_SIZE, CURRENT_JIN_SIZE and CURRENT_JIN_POSITION to choose sensible coordinates. The UI clamps out-of-bounds targets safely inside the available viewport.
Movement uses the current JIN_SPEED. You may change JIN_SPEED immediately before JIN_POSITION to crawl slowly or move almost instantly.
